Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa. Vasemm: Circuit diagram, not to scale. On the left is the Arduino board as a box with two connections on its right edge: 5V above and ground GND below. From the 5V connection a wire leads to the 330-ohm resistor R and from it to a red LED whose triangle points down: the anode is at the top on the resistor's side and the cathode at the bottom. From the LED a wire returns to the GND connection. A violet arrow shows the direction of the current I. No program is needed, as the 5V connection has a voltage whenever the USB cable is connected.
Kaksi kytkentäkaaviota vierekkäin, ei mi: Two circuit diagrams side by side, not to scale. On the left a series circuit: from the 5V connection the current flows through one 330-ohm resistor and two LEDs one after the other to the GND connection, so the current has only one path. On the right a parallel circuit: two branches leave the 5V connection, and each branch has its own 330-ohm resistor and its own LED before the branches join at the GND connection.
